_comment: source=ETL_JOB restricts the step catalog itself, at seed time, to CREATE_ORG_IN_FSP and ENABLE_PRM_LICENSES (plus the always-first INITIAL_REQUEST_VALIDATION) per source_config.json. Steps outside that set never get a row at all — they are absent from 'steps' entirely, not reported SKIPPED. progress/totalSteps only ever count the steps actually configured for this source (3, not 13). The steps that do run keep their normal catalog order relative to each other.
